en.headline: Man flees after private car with mismatched registration hits police vehicle in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Police said officers stopped a private car in Shun Fung Wai early Saturday that then collided with a police vehicle and drove off; the registration did not match records.
body: Police said New Territories North Regional officers were patrolling Shun Fung Wai in Tuen Mun at about 1:02am on Saturday when they stopped a private car suspected of a traffic violation.
The male driver then drove the car into a police vehicle and fled. Investigators later found that the car’s registration certificate did not match the vehicle registration records.
The case has been classified as using a false instrument. No one has been arrested and police are seeking the driver.

zh.headline: 屯門假牌私家車撞警車後逃逸 警追緝男司機
zh.dek: 警方表示，周六凌晨約1時2分在屯門順風圍截查一輛私家車時，男司機駕車撞向警車後逃去，車輛登記資料與行車證不符。
body: 警方表示，新界北總區人員周六凌晨約1時2分巡邏至屯門順風圍時，發現一輛私家車懷疑違反交通規例，遂上前截查。
期間男司機駕私家車撞向一輛警車後逃去。初步調查發現，該私家車的行車證與車輛登記資料不符。
案件列作「行使虛假文書」處理，暫未有人被捕，警方正追緝涉事男司機。
